name: hud_ui_composite_panel_set_text_fmt
description: HudUiCompositePanel::SetTextFmt builds a va_list and forwards to the composite text-format member behavior.
known_limits: No VC byte target covers 0x4bbaa0 yet; tier S remains open for a later HUD composite-panel text source-file pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly at 0x4bbaa0 validates the varargs wrapper shape: build va_list at the first variadic argument and dispatch self, format, and argList to the composite SetTextFmtV method slot.

The native composite-panel text-format smoke verifies SetTextFmt formats the active real transition-text entry, makes that entry visible, advances activeEntryCount, and invalidates the composite panel.
